lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: You said it yourself.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: If you found out that Mist was being made here,

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: you'd destroy this factory and everything in it.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I remember.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: And now that I've confirmed what's happening,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: that's exactly what I'll do.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That's what I must do.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I will tear down everything with my own hands.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I won't let you do that.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: If you're intent on destroying this place, you'll have to go through me.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: If you think I'm kidding, try me.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What is this? Why are you taking it this far?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I could ask you the same thing.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: We protected these people, and they thanked us by stabbing us in the back.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: As we speak, they're synthesizing a drug that kills people.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Do you know how many lives are being ruined because of this Mist?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You've seen what it does to people.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: This is beyond the pale.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Judgment has come to Fog Hollow.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: The people here are powerless.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Many people here did not want to produce Mist.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: But their lives were being threatened. They had no choice but to make it.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: If you destroy this place, what do you think will happen to these people?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: They're already on the edge of the precipice.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: If you go through with this,

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: you'll be tying the noose around their necks and throwing them off.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If that is what must happen, then so be it.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: They've left me with no choice.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: A crime is a crime.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Countless innocents have suffered because of these people.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If we want to solve this problem, we have to tear it out by the roots.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I know this is the right decision.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: No, you don't. You don't know that.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: You haven't had any dealings with Sixo.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Nothing you say

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: will change my mind.
Moran and Sugar stand opposite each other, locked in a vicious stare-down, each ready to pounce.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet, this place is dangerous. Come to me.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Partner, this way!
The situation is quickly becoming precarious. I...
Believe Moran is right.
Believe Sugar is right.
I trust Moran.
So I have faith in her decision.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Thank you, Cadet.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: ... I'm sorry to hear you say that, Partner.
*Thud*
*Pow pow pow*
Without any further discussion, the two Nikkes charge at each other.

lines.speaker: foghollowman
lines.text: Everyone, into the factory!
The villagers snatch the Mist that Moran dropped on the ground,
and then proceed to rush towards the factory.
*Pow*
Sugar's fist slams into Moran's cheek.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Argh!
*Pow*
Moran deals Sugar a crushing blow.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Ugh...!
A few moments later.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Whew... Whew...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Gasp... Gasp...
Both of their bodies are riddled with cuts and bruises both large and small.
Each of them is winded and attempting to catch their breath. As I go to try and break up the altercation...
*Bang*
A loud explosion rings out from the direction of the factory.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: ?! Dammit!
*Vroooom*
Sugar revs the engine and zooms off on her bike towards the factory.
We have to follow her!
*Grab*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet, wait.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Give me just a minute.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: My leg is giving me a bit of trouble.
You're bleeding!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: A little patching up and I'll be good as new.
I tend to Moran's injury as best as I can.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I can't thank you enough, Cadet.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Looks like I owe you another one.
You haven't changed your mind about destroying the village?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Well... to be exact,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I don't have a choice.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'm a member of Underworld Queen and the boss of the Peony Association.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I know that these people probably had little choice in the matter.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I can empathize. All too well.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: They didn't know where else to turn, and they got scared.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How could I not have noticed?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: For months, I watched them as they went about their lives.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: But no matter how much I care for them, some things cannot be excused.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Damning entire swathes of people to save yourself?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That's unforgivable.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Maybe things would have been different if they had told me about this sooner,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: but it's too late to turn back now.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Our members will be arriving soon.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: When they do, I plan to head straight to the factory.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So, let me ask you for one more favor.
What is it?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If you would, I'd like you to talk to Sugar first.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: She's been acting suspiciously before we even arrived at the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I've been concerned about her for a while now, but now I can see it clear as day.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: There's something going on between her and Sixo.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: She always reacts to the mention of that name.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That might be why she's gotten so wrapped up in this thing emotionally.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Since my stance on this matter is in opposition to Sugar's,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: there's no way I can objectively try to figure out

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: what she's thinking or what her intentions are.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That's not the case with you, though.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I don't want to fight with my comrades.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: She saved you earlier, and I'm incredibly grateful to her for that.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So, I'm begging you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Talk to her.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: At least until our reinforcements arrive.
I will.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Thank you.
Sugar is talking to some of the injured villagers.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Huh? Partner?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: What are you doing here?
I was worried.
Are these people injured because of that explosion earlier?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Like they told us earlier, this village has been rigged with explosives.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: When the bomb in the factory went off,

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: these people got caught in the disaster.
You're hurt too.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: It's okay, just a superficial scratch from Moran.
No, it's not okay.
I tend to Sugar's wound.
Have you changed your mind regarding what we should do to this village?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Absolutely not. I still feel the same.
Does this have anything to do with Sixo, by any chance?
I look at Sugar.
Do what you think is right.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: All right, then it's time to throw down.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet...
*Tadak*
*Pow pow pow*
Without any further discussion, the two Nikkes charge at each other.

lines.speaker: foghollowman
lines.text: Everyone, into the factory!
The villagers snatch the Mist that Moran dropped on the ground,
and then proceed to rush towards the factory.
*Pow*
Sugar's fist slams into Moran's cheek.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Argh!
*Pow*
Moran deals Sugar a crushing blow.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Ugh...!
A few moments later.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Whew... Whew...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Gasp... Gasp...
Both of their bodies are riddled with cuts and bruises both large and small.
Each of them is winded and attempting to catch their breath. As I go to try and break up the altercation...
*Bang*
A loud explosion rings out from the direction of the factory.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: ?! Dammit!

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Partner, let's go!
Okay!
Sugar revs the engine and we zoom off on her bike towards the factory.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: What is going on?

lines.speaker: foghollowman
lines.text: Argh... the explosives in the factory went off.

lines.speaker: foghollowman
lines.text: This has to be Sixo's doing.

lines.speaker: foghollowman
lines.text: But I don't understand... she said she wouldn't touch the factory.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: That's who she is.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Sixo never has been one to honor her word.

lines.speaker: cryingboy
lines.text: Mom! Wake up!

lines.speaker: slummen
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: We've got a lot of casualties here,

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: and we've got to extinguish this fire as well.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Partner, can you help me?
I'm on it.
We get to work,
moving those who are injured and providing first aid.
You're hurt too.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: It's okay, just a superficial scratch from Moran.
No, it's not okay.
I tend to Sugar's wound.
Have you changed your mind regarding what we should do to this village?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Absolutely not. I still feel the same.
Does this have anything to do with Sixo, by any chance?
You seem to know more about Sixo than you should.
Perhaps that explains why you've been so wary about this whole venture.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: ... So, it was that obvious, huh?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Yes, you're right.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I received a request from Sixo.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I am to protect Fog Hollow.
What?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Do you remember that I used to live in the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: At that time, I was doing a lot of work for Sixo.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Dangerous assignments, at that.
When was this?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: A while back, when I was in a different squad.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Back then, there wasn't a person in the Outer Rim who didn't know who I was.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: But I wasn't renowned. I was infamous.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: People in the streets avoided me.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: There were rumors that wherever I went, bad things were sure to follow.
It's hard imagining you like that.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: That was the old me.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I didn't think for myself. I simply followed orders like a mindless machine.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Until one day...

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I heard something terrible had happened because of what I did.

lines.speaker: outerrimman
lines.text: You monster!

lines.speaker: outerrimman
lines.text: You said we were family! You said you would protect us!

lines.speaker: outerrimman
lines.text: How could you do this?!

lines.speaker: outerrimman
lines.text: What are you going to do now, huh?! Answer me!

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: After that, I washed my hands of Sixo.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I didn't want to have to recall any more memories like that one.
Then why did you accept the request?

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: My plan was to take a calculated risk and try to dig up some information on Sixo.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I figured I could at least turn up something on her, but instead,

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: I got myself involved in another gigantic mess like I always do.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: She knew perfectly well

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: this is how I would react to what was going on here.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: She had everything planned out in advance. She's the one who asked me to wear this outfit.
You and Moran have mentioned this outfit several times.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Yes, it's what I always wore back when I was operating in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: The instant anyone saw these clothes, they knew to stay away.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: They were like a scarlet letter.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: A marker, letting everyone know the sins I'd committed. Sixo wants to remind me of what I did.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: She doesn't want me to forget how big a part I played in all of it.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: That's why I want to stop Moran from doing this.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Once a sin has been committed, it can never be undone.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: You can repent, and you can regret, but you can never truly go back to the way you were.
*Step step step*

lines.speaker: slummen
lines.text: M-Miss!

lines.speaker: slummen
lines.text: Moran is here!

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: Partner.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: This is gonna be one hell of a fight.

lines.speaker: sugar_g
lines.text: So stay back, okay?
